racial_abilities.description: Unlimited advancement in all character classes (standard human ability; no character point cost).
Humans receive 10 character points to spend on abilities/proficiencies or save for later.
Attack bonus (5): +1 to attack with any weapon of the human's choice.
Balance bonus (10): +1 bonus to the character's Balance subability score.
Experience bonus (10): +5% experience point bonus.
Health bonus (10): +1 bonus to the character's Health subability score.
Hit point bonus (10): One additional hit point whenever new hit points are rolled on level gain.
Secret doors (10): Chance to detect secret and concealed doors, especially while searching.
Tough hide (10): Natural Armor Class 8; if armor is AC 8 or worse, add +1 AC bonus.

Alchemist specialist package: +1 save vs Alchemy spells, bonus Alchemy spell per level, know all Alchemy spells. Opposition: Illusion & Necromancy.
Transmuter specialist package: +1 save vs Alteration spells, bonus Alteration spell per level, know all Alteration spells. Opposition: Abjuration & Necromancy.
Conjurer specialist package: +1 save vs Conjuration/Summoning spells, bonus Conj. spell per level, know all Conj. spells. Opposition: Greater Divination & Invocation/Evocation.
Diviner specialist package: +1 save vs Divination spells, bonus Divination spell per level, know all Divination spells. Opposition: Conjuration/Summoning.

Restriction - Awkward casting method (5): Wizard's spellcasting is extremely obvious — brilliant lights, shouted components, or waves of sensation alert anyone nearby. Casting from ambush or discretely is nearly impossible. Gain 5 CP.

Restriction - Hazardous spells (10): Each time wizard casts a spell, must save vs. breath weapon or suffer 1 damage per spell level; or a cumulative 1%/level chance of insanity lasting 3d4 days. Gain 10 CP.
Restriction - Reduced hit points (10): Uses d3 Hit Die instead of d4; Constitution hit point bonus capped at +1 per die. Gain 10 CP.
Restriction - Reduced spell knowledge (7): Maximum spells known per level is halved (or capped at 10 if Intelligence would allow knowing all spells). Gain 7 CP.
Restriction - Slower casting time (2/5): All casting times increase by 3 (2 CP), or jump to the next greater time unit — 1-9 becomes 1 round, rounds become turns, etc. (5 CP). Gain 2 or 5 CP.

Restriction - Behavior/taboo (2): Wizard must follow an unusual code of behavior (specific dress, food avoidance, no physical contact, etc.); violating it causes loss of all memorized spells. Gain 2 CP.

Restriction - Difficult memorization (5): Wizard can only memorize spells under very specific circumstances (e.g., only in his lab, in a temple of the god of magic, or after a full-day rite). Gain 5 CP.

Restriction - Environmental condition (5+): Wizard can only cast spells under certain conditions (e.g., only by day, near a favored element, no priests nearby). DM assigns 5–20 CP based on how frequently the restriction applies. Gain 5–20 CP.

Restriction - Supernatural constraint (5+): Wizard has an unavoidable supernatural vulnerability — e.g., cannot cross running water, cannot enter a home without invitation, lost at crossroads. DM assigns 5–15 CP based on impact. Gain 5–15 CP.

Restriction - Talisman (8): Wizard's magical power is linked to a specific object (crystal, staff, amulet, ring, etc.); spells cannot be cast without it. If destroyed, 1d4 weeks of work creates a new one. Gain 8 CP.

Restriction - Weapons restriction (3/5): May never have weapon proficiency (3 CP), or may never attempt to wield a weapon at all — doing so renders spellcasting impossible for one full month (5 CP). Gain 3 or 5 CP.

Restriction - Difficult spell acquisition (5): Druid can pray for spells only under very specific circumstances (e.g., only in a sacred grove, only at certain celestial alignments, or after 3 days of fasting). Gain 5 CP.

Restriction - Hazardous spells (10): Channeling nature's power is dangerous; druid suffers 1 damage per spell level (save vs. breath for half), or has a 5%/level chance (−2%/character level, min 1%) of losing all spells and being feebleminded for 1d3 days. Gain 10 CP.

Restriction - Limited magical item use (5+): Druid is banned from certain magical item categories. For each barred category — potions/oils/scrolls; rings; rods/staves/wands; miscellaneous magic; weapons and armor — gain 5 CP.
Restriction - Reduced hit points (10/20): Uses d6 Hit Die instead of d8 (10 CP), or d4 Hit Die (20 CP). Gain 10 or 20 CP.

Restriction - Reduced spell progression (15): Druid memorizes one less spell of each level than normal; 1st-level druid gains 0 first-level spells, and no bonus Wisdom spells for reduced levels. Gain 15 CP.
Restriction - Slower casting times (5): Druid's spells are long-winded; all casting times increase by 3, or casting times of 1 round or longer are doubled. Gain 5 CP.

Restriction - Weapon restriction (5/15): Druid further restricted to staff, club, war hammer, horseman's mace, and horseman's flail (5 CP); or may never gain proficiency in any weapon (15 CP). Gain 5 or 15 CP.

Restriction - Behavior/taboo (2): Druid must follow an unusual code of conduct tied to nature (e.g., always speak a prayer before felling a tree, never enter a city); violating it requires penance to regain spells. Gain 2 CP.

Restriction - Ceremony/observance (5): Druid must perform a daily natural ceremony (dawn meditation, moonrise ritual, etc.); missing it risks losing memorized spells or suffering divine disfavor from nature. Gain 5 CP.

Restriction - Fanaticism (5): Druid's faith is intolerant of those who despoil nature; refuses companions who cut forests or kill animals wantonly, and suffers −4 reaction with those who openly harm nature. Gain 5 CP.

Restriction - Limited spell selection (5): Druid must build a spell book like a wizard; spells per level capped by Intelligence, and a learn-spells roll is required to add each new nature spell. Gain 5 CP.

Restriction - Talisman/symbol (8): Druid's power is focused through one sacred natural object (a specific stone, carved branch, or totem); without it, no spells can be cast. Creating a replacement takes 1d4 weeks of fasting and communion with nature. Gain 8 CP.
